(l)(15)(ii): extensions in ≤2-year increments; total ≤7 years; no further extensions.
obligations.threshold: 7 years cumulative L-1A. ≤2-year increments. Recapture: time physically outside the U.S. does not count; a full year abroad resets eligibility.
obligations.deadline: Hard cap at 7 years; after the cap, readmission requires 1 continuous year abroad (subject to the exceptions rule).
obligations.citation: INA 214(c)(2)(D)(i) (8 USC 1184(c)(2)(D)); 8 CFR 214.2(l)(12)(i); (l)(15)(ii); USCIS PM Vol 2 Part L Ch 9 / Part M Ch 9.
obligations.data_needed: classification (L-1A); cumulative_us_l_days_or_years; admission_history; periods_physically_outside_us; days_in_other_status_H_or_L; current_validity_end; requested_extension_period; recapture_claim_days.

obligations.check: (L-1B) Total stay in specialized-knowledge capacity ≤5 years.
obligations.requirement: Statute (INA 214(c)(2)(D)(ii)): total "shall not exceed 5 years." Reg (8 CFR 214.2(l)(12)(i)): one who has spent 5 years in a SK capacity may not be readmitted under (L) unless physically present outside the U.S. for the immediate prior year. (l)(15)(ii): ≤2-year increments; total ≤5 years.
obligations.threshold: 5 years cumulative L-1B. ≤2-year increments. Time physically outside the U.S. is recapturable; 1 full year abroad resets eligibility.
obligations.deadline: Hard cap at 5 years; readmission thereafter requires 1 continuous year abroad (subject to the exceptions rule).
obligations.citation: INA 214(c)(2)(D)(ii) (8 USC 1184(c)(2)(D)); 8 CFR 214.2(l)(12)(i); (l)(15)(ii); USCIS PM Vol 2 Part L Ch 9.
obligations.data_needed: classification (L-1B); cumulative_us_l_days_or_years; admission_history; periods_physically_outside_us; days_in_other_status_H_or_L; current_validity_end; requested_extension_period; recapture_claim_days.

obligations.check: (L-1B) The beneficiary possesses, and the role requires, specialized knowledge per regulation and statute.
obligations.requirement: Specialized knowledge (8 CFR 214.2(l)(1)(ii)(D)) = "special knowledge possessed by an individual of the petitioning organization's product, service, research, equipment, techniques, management, or other interests and its application in international markets, OR an advanced level of knowledge or expertise in the organization's processes and procedures." Statute (INA 214(c)(2)(B)): "special knowledge of the company product and its application in international markets" OR "an advanced level of knowledge of processes and procedures." A "specialized knowledge professional" ((l)(1)(ii)(E)) must also be a professional per INA 101(a)(32).
obligations.threshold: Either "special" (product/service + international-market application) OR "advanced" (org processes/procedures) knowledge. Sufficiency by preponderance of the evidence on the totality of factors (USCIS PM Vol 2 Part L Ch 4).
obligations.deadline: n/a (tested at each adjudication; max stay 5 years).
obligations.citation: 8 CFR 214.2(l)(1)(ii)(D); (l)(1)(ii)(E); INA 214(c)(2)(B) (8 USC 1184(c)(2)(B)); USCIS PM Vol 2 Part L Ch 4.
obligations.data_needed: requested_classification (L-1B); knowledge_type (special_product_knowledge|advanced_process_knowledge); description_of_knowledge; how_acquired; time_to_train_replacement; uniqueness_within_company; is_professional_flag; international_market_application_flag.

obligations.check: (L-1B only) If the beneficiary will be stationed PRIMARILY at an unaffiliated employer's worksite, the statutory third-party-placement ineligibility bar does NOT apply.
obligations.requirement: INA 214(c)(2)(F): an L-1B beneficiary stationed primarily at the worksite of an employer other than the petitioner (or its affiliate/subsidiary/parent) is INELIGIBLE if either (i) "controlled and supervised principally by such unaffiliated employer"; OR (ii) the placement is "essentially an arrangement to provide labor for hire … rather than a placement in connection with the provision of a product or service for which specialized knowledge specific to the petitioning employer is necessary." To avoid the bar, show BOTH: (1) control/supervision stays principally with the petitioner, AND (2) placement is for a product/service requiring the petitioner's specialized knowledge (not labor-for-hire).
obligations.threshold: "Primarily" stationed at the third-party site triggers the test. "Principally" controlled/supervised by the unaffiliated employer = bar applies. Both safe-harbor prongs must be satisfied.
obligations.deadline: n/a (eligibility condition; applies for any period at a third-party site).
obligations.citation: INA 214(c)(2)(F)(i)-(ii) (8 USC 1184(c)(2)(F)); USCIS PM Vol 2 Part L Ch 4 (off-site placement); DOS 9 FAM 402.12.
obligations.data_needed: primary_worksite_is_third_party_flag; unaffiliated_client_entity; who_controls_supervises (petitioner|client|both); product_or_service_provided; specialized_knowledge_specific_to_petitioner_flag; labor_for_hire_indicator; itinerary_of_worksites.

obligations.check: If a dependent/willful-violator employer relies on the exempt carve-out, every worker on the LCA is genuinely exempt ($60,000+ or master's-or-higher in a related specialty).
obligations.requirement: A dependent/willful-violator employer is relieved of the 655.738/.739 attestations for an LCA used exclusively for exempt workers. Exempt if (1) wages (incl. assured cash bonuses, NOT benefits) ≥$60,000/yr, or (2) a master's-or-higher degree (or equivalent) in a specialty related to the employment. $60,000 is a full-year cash figure actually received, free and clear, not pro-rated for PT, not met with benefits.
obligations.threshold: $60,000/yr cash (full-time-rate, actual receipt) OR master's-or-higher in a related specialty.
obligations.deadline: Assessed at LCA/petition filing; the $60,000 must actually be received.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.737(b) (definition: $60,000 / master's, at (b)(1)/(b)(2)); 655.737(c) (measurement rules: benefits excluded, assured-bonus only, cash free and clear, full $60k received, no PT proration).
obligations.data_needed: Per worker on the LCA: annual cash wage (excl. benefits) + actual receipt; assured-bonus components; degree level + field + relatedness; FT/PT.
evidence_required: Per worker on the LCA: annual cash wage (excl. benefits) + actual receipt

obligations.check: Employer correctly determines H-1B-dependency (7/12/15% tests), which switches on the extra non-displacement + recruitment attestations.
obligations.requirement: H-1B-DEPENDENT if: ≤25 FTE & >7 H-1B; or 26–50 FTE & >12 H-1B; or ≥51 FTE & H-1B ≥15% of FTEs. A willful violator (within prior 5 years) is treated like a dependent employer. FT = 40 hrs/week (floor 35). Status switches on the 655.738 (non-displacement) and 655.739 (recruitment) attestations, unless the LCA is exempt-only.
obligations.threshold: ≤25 FTE & >7; 26–50 & >12; ≥51 & ≥15%. FT = 40 (floor 35). Willful-violator look-back = 5 years.
obligations.deadline: As of each LCA filing (and petition filing).
obligations.citation: **20 CFR 655.736(a)(1)(i)-(iii)** (three-part test); **655.736(c)(2)** (snap-shot); **655.736(g)** (consequences/attestations, cross-ref 655.738/.739); **655.736(a)(2)(iii)(A)** (FTE / full-time = 40 hrs, floor 35); **655.736(f)** (willful-violator, 5-yr look-back). **The definitions of "H-1B-dependent employer," "willful violator," and "full-time employee" are in 655.736, NOT 655.715**; "exempt H-1B nonimmigrant" is at 655.736(g)/655.737.
obligations.data_needed: FTE U.S. employee count (with hours; floor 35); H-1B worker count (FT + PT); prior willful-violation finding within 5 yrs (Y/N); exempt-only-LCA flag.

obligations.check: (Dependent/willful-violator, non-exempt LCA) No U.S. worker in an essentially-equivalent job displaced within 90 days before to 90 days after petition filing — including a secondary-employer inquiry.
obligations.requirement: Non-exempt LCA: attest no displacement of a U.S. worker in an essentially equivalent job in the area within 90 days before and 90 days after petition filing (DIRECT). For placement with a secondary employer, must have inquired and have no knowledge that the secondary employer displaced/intends to displace a similarly-employed U.S. worker within 90/90 of placement (SECONDARY). "Lay off" excludes discharge for cause, voluntary departure/retirement, expiration of a grant/contract (with conditions, not a temporary-contract evasion), and refusal of a bona fide similar offer at equal/greater pay.
obligations.threshold: 90 days before AND 90 days after petition filing (direct) / placement (secondary). "Essentially equivalent" = comparable duties/qualifications in the same area (commuting distance / same MSA).
obligations.deadline: Prohibition spans the 180-day window; the secondary inquiry must precede placement.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.738(c) (direct, 90/90); 655.738(d) (secondary, inquiry + 90/90); 655.738(b) (definitions: lay off; essentially equivalent job; same-area/MSA test); 655.738(e) (documentation).
obligations.data_needed: Dependency/willful-violator + exempt-only flags; petition filing date; U.S.-worker separations same occupation/area within ±90 days (+ reason codes); secondary-placement flag + date + documented inquiry; essentially-equivalent-job mapping.
evidence_required: U.S.-worker separations same occupation/area within ±90 days (+ reason codes)

obligations.check: (Dependent/willful-violator, non-exempt LCA) Good-faith industry-standard recruitment of U.S. workers at ≥ required wage; job offered to any equally/better-qualified U.S. applicant; documented in the PAF.
obligations.requirement: Non-exempt LCA: take good-faith steps to recruit U.S. workers using industry-wide standard procedures (internal + external + some active recruitment, not lowest-common-denominator), at compensation ≥ required wage, and offer the job to any equally/better-qualified U.S. applicant. Retain documentation; PAF summary.
obligations.threshold: Recruitment comp ≥ required wage; offer mandatory to any equally/better-qualified U.S. applicant. No fixed ad count; must meet industry norms.
obligations.deadline: Recruitment before filing; documentation retained per 655.760; PAF recruitment summary.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.739(e) (industry-wide standards: (e)(1) internal+external, (e)(2) some active); 655.739(f)-(g) (legitimate, non-skewing criteria); 655.739(i)(4) (PAF summary); 655.739(j) (must offer to qualified U.S. applicant, 8 USC 1182(n)(1)(G)(i)(II), DOJ-enforced).
obligations.data_needed: Dependency/exempt flags; recruitment method list with dates/places; compensation offered vs required wage; applicant log + disposition; record of any equally/better-qualified U.S. applicant and whether offered; PAF recruitment summary present.
evidence_required: record of any equally/better-qualified U.S. applicant and whether offered

obligations.check: Map any violation to back wages + the correct CMP tier ($2,364 / $9,624 / $67,367, 2025) + debarment (1/2/3 yrs).
obligations.requirement: On a violation, WHD assesses back wages/fringe owed; CMPs tiered (substantial/other-than-willful; willful/misrepresentation/whistleblower; willful + displacement in the 90/90 window). Debarment ≥1/≥2/≥3 years.
obligations.threshold: Back wages: full make-whole. CMP per violation: $2,364 (tier1) / $9,624 (tier2) / $67,367 (tier3) [2025]. Debarment ≥1/≥2/≥3 years.
obligations.deadline: Back wages for the full underpayment period; WHD complaint generally within 12 months of the violation (655.806).
obligations.citation: **20 CFR 655.810(a)** (back wages); **655.810(b)(1)/(b)(2)/(b)(3)** (CMP tiers); **655.810(d)(1)-(3)** (debarment); INA 212(n)(2) / 8 USC 1182(n)(2) (base $1,000/$5,000/$35,000); complaint limitations **655.806(a)(5)** (12 months). **§655.810 is in SUBPART I, not Subpart H** — use `.../subpart-I/section-655.810`. Current figures are the amounts codified in current **20 CFR 655.810** and confirmed by the DOL WHD Civil Money Penalty table; DOL made **no 2026 inflation adjustment** (91 FR 31358, May 27, 2026), so the 2025 amounts remain in force for 2026. **29 CFR 580 is procedural only, and 29 CFR 578 is FLSA-specific; neither is the H-1B LCA amount source.**
obligations.data_needed: Per violation: type; willful flag; displacement-within-90/90 flag; workers affected; underpayment amount + period; good-faith/history factors.

obligations.check: LCA used only within its certified validity period; H-1B petition not relying on an expired/withdrawn LCA.
obligations.requirement: Certified LCA valid for the DOL-stated period, ≤3 years for H-1B (E-3 ≤2; **H-1B1 initial ≤3 — same as H-1B**; H-1B1 extension ≤2). Validity cannot begin before certification. May be filed no earlier than 6 months before the start date.
obligations.threshold: Max validity 3 years (H-1B). Earliest filing: 6 months before start.
obligations.deadline: Employment within [certified start, certified end]; filing ≥ start−6 months.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.750(a) (validity, 3-yr max); 20 CFR 655.730(b) (no earlier than 6 months before start).
obligations.data_needed: Per LCA: certified start, certified end, filing date, intended start; mapped H-1B petition validity dates.

obligations.check: Each H-1B worker received a copy of the ETA-certified LCA no later than their first day of work.
obligations.requirement: Provide the H-1B worker a copy of the certified LCA (ETA-9035/9035E) no later than the date the worker reports to work (cover pages ETA-9035CP on request).
obligations.threshold: By the first workday.
obligations.deadline: On/before the worker's first day of work.
obligations.data_needed: Per worker: certified-LCA-delivered date; worker first-report-to-work date; acknowledgment of receipt (if captured).

obligations.check: Notice to the bargaining rep, OR posted in 2 conspicuous locations for 10 days / delivered electronically, on or within 30 days before filing, with required content and dated proof.
obligations.requirement: Attestation 4: notify the bargaining rep (if any) on or within 30 days before filing; OR, if none, post hard-copy notice in ≥2 conspicuous locations at each place of employment for a total of 10 days, OR provide electronic notification to affected employees for 10 days. Content: H-1B sought; number; occupational classification; wage rate; period; location(s); LCA available for public inspection; complaints may be filed with U.S. DOL.
obligations.threshold: 2 physical posting locations per worksite; 10 days posted/available; window = on or within 30 days BEFORE filing.
obligations.deadline: Posting on/within 30 days before filing; hard-copy stays up 10 days; electronic available 10 days.
obligations.citation: **20 CFR 655.734(a)(1)(i)** (bargaining-rep notice + content + WHD statement, 30-days-before); **655.734(a)(1)(ii)** chapeau (no-rep notice content + "available for public inspection" + WHD statement); **655.734(a)(1)(ii)(A)** and **(a)(1)(ii)(A)(3)** (≥2 conspicuous locations, posted on/within 30 days before, 10 days); **655.734(a)(1)(ii)(B)** (electronic notice, 10 days, single direct e-mail suffices); **655.734(b)** (documentation); **655.734(c)/§655.760** (retention). **DROP the cite to "655.734(a)(1)(iii)" for content** — no such paragraph exists (content is carried in (a)(1)(i) and the (a)(1)(ii) chapeau).
obligations.data_needed: Per LCA: bargaining-rep exists? + notice date; OR posting locations (count + addresses) + start date + take-down date (≥10 days); OR electronic-notice method + window; content fields present; filing date.
evidence_required: Per LCA: bargaining-rep exists? + notice date
OR posting locations (count + addresses) + start date + take-down date (≥10 days

obligations.check: Every active worker in an LCA-bearing class (H-1B, H-1B1, E-3) has a certified Labor Condition Application on file covering their employment.
obligations.requirement: Certified LCA accompanies the H-1B petition and was filed no earlier than 6 months before the employment start date.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.730(b) (no earlier than 6 months); 20 CFR 655.730(c)(3) (certified LCA submitted to USCIS with I-129).
obligations.data_needed: worker visa class; certified LCA records linked to the worker (case number, validity dates).
evidence_required: certified LCA records linked to the worker (case number, validity dates)

obligations.check: A complete PAF assembled within 1 working day of filing, kept at the principal place of business or place of employment.
obligations.requirement: Within one working day of filing, make available for public examination a PAF containing: (1) certified LCA + ETA-9035CP (signed printout if electronic); (2) wage-rate documentation; (3) full clear explanation of the actual-wage system; (4) prevailing-wage documentation (source + methodology); (5) union/employee notice documentation; (6) benefits summary; and for H-1B-dependent/willful-violator employers, (9) exempt-worker list and (10) recruitment methods/time-frame summary (plus (7) corporate-change sworn statement and (8) single-employer entity list where applicable).
obligations.threshold: Assembled within 1 WORKING DAY of filing; the enumerated documents (conditional items by status).
obligations.deadline: Within one working day after filing.
obligations.citation: **20 CFR 655.760(a)** — the introductory text of (a) (1-working-day + location) and items **(a)(1)-(a)(6)** for the six core documents, plus **(a)(9)** (exempt-worker list) and **(a)(10)** (recruitment summary) for dependent/willful-violator employers (and (a)(7) corporate-restructuring, (a)(8) single-employer list). **NOT "(a)(1)-(7)"** — paragraph (a) runs through (a)(10); (a)(7) is the corporate-restructuring sworn statement, not the recruitment summary.
obligations.data_needed: Per LCA: presence/date of each PAF component; PAF assembly date vs filing date; PAF storage location; H-1B-dependent/willful flag (drives (a)(9)/(a)(10)); corporate-change/single-employer flag.
evidence_required: Per LCA: presence/date of each PAF component
PAF assembly date vs filing date

obligations.check: PAF documents retained 1 year past the period of employment (or LCA expiry/withdrawal); payroll records retained 3 years from creation.
obligations.requirement: PAF retained 1 year beyond the last date any H-1B worker is employed under the LCA, or 1 year from expiry/withdrawal if none employed. Payroll/wage records (655.731(b)) retained 3 years from creation. Extended while an enforcement proceeding is pending (payroll).
obligations.threshold: PAF: 1 year beyond end of employment (or expiry/withdrawal). Payroll: 3 years from creation.
obligations.deadline: PAF = employment_end + 1yr; payroll = creation + 3yr (later if enforcement pending).
obligations.data_needed: Per LCA: last date a worker was employed / expiry-or-withdrawal date; per payroll record: creation date; open-enforcement flag.
evidence_required: Per LCA: last date a worker was employed / expiry-or-withdrawal date

obligations.check: LCA and public-access-file records are retained for the required periods, and are not destroyed while a legal hold applies.
obligations.requirement: PAF documents retained 1 year past the period of employment (or LCA expiry/withdrawal); payroll records retained 3 years from creation. PAF records retained 1 year beyond the last date any H-1B worker is employed under the LCA — or, if none employed, 1 year from LCA expiration/withdrawal. Payroll records for H-1B employees AND comparator employees in the same occupational classification retained 3 years from creation (indefinitely if enforcement commenced).
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.760(c); cross-ref 655.731(b).; penalty 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1)(vi); DOL WHD Fact Sheet #62F.
obligations.data_needed: LCA certification and expiration dates; PAF retention records; payroll record retention; any legal-hold or enforcement-proceeding flag.

obligations.check: No strike/lockout in the occupation at the place of employment as of filing; if one arises post-certification, notify ETA within 3 days and stop placing H-1B workers there.
obligations.requirement: Attestation 3: as of filing, no strike/lockout in the occupational classification in the area of intended employment. If one occurs after submission, notify ETA within 3 days (mail/fax/private carrier) and do not place/assign/lease/contract out an H-1B worker to any place of employment with such a strike/lockout until ETA determines it ended. ETA may certify to DHS under 8 CFR 214.2(h)(17).
obligations.threshold: 3 days to notify ETA. Scope = the named occupational classification at the place of employment (post-cert no-placement); attestation as-of-filing scope = area of intended employment.
obligations.deadline: Notice to ETA within 3 days; cessation of placement immediate.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.733(a); 655.733(a)(1) (3-day ETA notice); 655.733(a)(2) (ETA certification to DHS, 8 CFR 214.2(h)(17)).
obligations.data_needed: Per worksite/occupation: active labor-dispute/strike/lockout flag + start date; ETA notice sent date; H-1B placements at the affected worksite; occupational classification.
evidence_required: Per worksite/occupation: active labor-dispute/strike/lockout flag + start date
H-1B placements at the affected worksite

obligations.check: To cut off wage/benching liability: (1) expressly terminated the worker, (2) notified USCIS to revoke the petition, and (3) paid the reasonable cost of return transportation to the worker's last foreign residence.
obligations.requirement: Wage liability (incl. non-productive time) does not end until a BONA FIDE termination. Per DOL ARB (Amtel): (1) expressly terminate; (2) notify USCIS so the petition can be revoked; (3) provide return transportation abroad for an involuntary dismissal before the end of authorized admission. Until all three, the employer remains liable.
obligations.threshold: All three elements (return-transportation only for employer-initiated/involuntary terminations, to the last foreign residence). Worker has a separate 60-day grace period under 8 CFR 214.1(l)(2).
obligations.deadline: Wage clock stops only on the date the LAST of the three is completed; until then back wages accrue.
obligations.citation: Core test **20 CFR 655.731(c)(7)(ii) AS CONSTRUED BY DOL ARB in Amtel Group of Fla., Inc. v. Yongmahapakorn, ARB No. 04-087 (Sept. 29, 2006)**; supporting **8 CFR 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(E)** (return transportation; not on voluntary resignation) and **8 CFR 214.2(h)(11)** (notify USCIS / revocation). **REMOVE the USCIS "Options for Nonimmigrant Workers Following Termination" archive page** as authority for the employer test — it is worker-side grace-period guidance (archived 2025).
obligations.data_needed: Per terminated worker: express-termination date + evidence; USCIS withdrawal/revocation-request date + confirmation; return-transportation paid/provided date + amount (involuntary); voluntary/involuntary flag; last day worked / last paid date; authorized-stay end date.
evidence_required: Per terminated worker: express-termination date + evidence
last day worked / last paid date

obligations.check: LCA used only within its certified validity period; H-1B petition not relying on an expired/withdrawn LCA.
obligations.requirement: Certified LCA valid for the DOL-stated period, ≤3 years for H-1B (E-3 ≤2; **H-1B1 initial ≤3 — same as H-1B**; H-1B1 extension ≤2). Validity cannot begin before certification. May be filed no earlier than 6 months before the start date.
obligations.threshold: Max validity 3 years (H-1B). Earliest filing: 6 months before start.
obligations.deadline: Employment within [certified start, certified end]; filing ≥ start−6 months.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.750(a) (validity, 3-yr max); 20 CFR 655.730(b) (no earlier than 6 months before start).
obligations.data_needed: Per LCA: certified start, certified end, filing date, intended start; mapped H-1B petition validity dates.

obligations.check: No deduction reduces the wage below the required wage unless in one of three authorized categories; employer business expenses (incl. ACWIA fee) never passed to the worker.
obligations.requirement: A deduction may reduce cash wage below required wage ONLY if (1) required by law (tax, FICA); (2) CBA-authorized, or reasonable-and-customary in the occupation/area (not a recoupment of employer business expense); or (3) a voluntary, written-authorized deduction principally for the worker's benefit, not a business-expense recoupment, ≤ fair market value, within CCPA garnishment limits. May not recoup the ACWIA fee or other employer business expenses; early-cessation penalties prohibited.
obligations.threshold: Post-deduction cash wage ≥ required wage unless category (1)/(2)/(3). ACWIA fee ($500/$1,000 by employer size) and the $500 fraud fee non-recoupable in full.
obligations.deadline: Each pay period.
obligations.citation: **20 CFR 655.731(c)(9)(i)-(iii)** (three authorized categories; business-expense bar at (c)(9)(iii)(C)); **655.731(c)(10)(i)** (early-cessation PENALTY prohibition; penalty-vs-liquidated-damages under State law); **655.731(c)(10)(ii)** (worker may not pay any part of the $500/$1,000 additional filing fee). **NOT (c)(11)** — (c)(11) is the separate "unauthorized deduction = non-payment of wages" rule. The $500 fraud-prevention fee = INA 214(c)(12)/8 USC 1184(c)(12), recoupment barred via (c)(9)(iii)(C)/(c)(10)(i).
obligations.data_needed: Per worker/period: itemized deductions with category code; written authorization on file (Y/N); whether the item is an employer business expense; FMV basis; any training-fee/visa-cost/attorney-fee/breach-penalty charged to the worker; net wage vs required wage.
evidence_required: Per worker/period: itemized deductions with category code
whether the item is an employer business expense

obligations.check: Worker in employer-caused non-productive status still paid the full required wage; non-payment only where the (c)(7)(ii) exception applies.
obligations.requirement: Non-productive status due to an EMPLOYER decision (lack of work, lack of permit/license, any reason except (c)(7)(ii)) ⇒ pay salaried the full pro-rata amount, or hourly for a full-time week (40 hrs, or the employer's demonstrated full-time number), at the required wage. Need NOT pay for non-productive time due to conditions UNRELATED to employment that EITHER (a) take the worker away at their voluntary request/convenience, OR (b) render them unable to work — subject to benefit plans and FMLA/ADA.
obligations.threshold: Salaried: full pro-rata salary at required wage. Hourly: a full-time week (40 hrs, or the employer's demonstrated full-time number) at required wage; PT LCAs pay ≥ the I-129 hours. The (c)(7)(ii) exception applies when the period is due to conditions UNRELATED to employment that EITHER (a) are at the worker's voluntary request/convenience OR (b) render the worker unable to work — **these are alternative limbs joined by OR, not a single "voluntary + unable-to-work" test**; and not to the extent payable under the employer's benefit plan or FMLA/ADA. *(Original threshold wrongly required "(a) unrelated AND (b) voluntary rendering unable to work.")*
obligations.deadline: Continuous — every pay period of the non-productive period.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.731(c)(7)(i) (pay required); 655.731(c)(7)(ii) (exception).
obligations.data_needed: Per worker/period: productive/non-productive flag; reason code (employer-caused vs worker-voluntary-non-employment); FT/PT + full-time-hours definition; wage paid; approved-leave/FMLA/ADA flag; benefit-plan PTO usage.

obligations.check: H-1B workers offered the same benefits package on the same criteria as similarly-employed U.S. workers; benefits actually received.
obligations.requirement: Benefits and eligibility offered on the SAME BASIS and SAME CRITERIA as U.S. workers; no stricter rules; not denied as "temporary." Good-faith offers resulting in actual receipt. Limited home-country options for ≤90-day short-term and >90-day extended multinational assignments.
obligations.threshold: Same package + same criteria. Multinational home-country cut-off: 90 consecutive calendar days. Identicality not required where the worker voluntarily elects different options from the same package.
obligations.deadline: Throughout the longer of LCA validity or H-1B employment.
obligations.citation: **20 CFR 655.731(c)(3)(i)-(iii)** (requirement + threshold) and **documentation at 655.731(c)(3)** (and cross-referenced (b)(3) recordkeeping). **DROP the (b)(1) documentation pin** — (b)(1) is general payroll/wage-statement documentation, not the benefits-documentation duty.
obligations.data_needed: Benefit plan eligibility rules; enrollment records H-1B vs U.S.-worker cohort same occupation; waiting-period/vesting; for multinationals: assignment length + home-country enrollment + reciprocal-treatment evidence.
evidence_required: enrollment records H-1B vs U.S.-worker cohort same occupation
for multinationals: assignment length + home-country enrollment + reciprocal-tre

obligations.check: Prevailing wage from an acceptable source, correct skill level, within its validity window at filing.
obligations.requirement: PW determined as of filing from an acceptable source: arms-length CBA; OFLC NPWC PWD (arithmetic mean of OES/OEWS at level I–IV); independent authoritative survey; or another legitimate source. An OFLC PWD is valid ≥90 days and ≤1 year from determination.
obligations.threshold: PWD validity ≥90 and ≤365 days. Survey recency: data collected within 24 months preceding publication; latest published edition (published within 24 months before filing). Academic/research employers: level reflects only such institutions.
obligations.deadline: Determined as of filing; OFLC PWD must be valid on the filing date.
obligations.citation: **20 CFR 655.731(a)(2)** (PW determined "as of the time of filing"; greater-of); **655.731(a)(2)(i)** (CBA); **655.731(a)(2)(ii) / (a)(2)(ii)(A)** (OFLC NPC/OES, arithmetic mean of BLS OES); **655.731(a)(2)(ii)(A)** (validity "not less than 90 days or more than 1 year") and **(a)(2)(ii)(A)(1)** (file LCA within the PWD validity period); **655.731(a)(2)(ii)(B)/(C)** (independent authoritative / other legitimate source); **655.731(a)(2)(vii)** (academic/nonprofit-research carve-out); **655.731(b)(3) / (b)(3)(iii)(B)-(C)** (documentation incl. 24-month recency). **For the wage LEVEL I–IV tiering, cite 20 CFR 656.40(b)(2) + DOL OFLC PW guidance, NOT 655.731** ("level I-IV" does not appear in 655.731).
obligations.data_needed: PW source type; PWD tracking number + issue + expiration (if OFLC); OES area + SOC + level; survey publication date + data-collection window; CBA citation; employer entity-type flag (academic/research).
evidence_required: PWD tracking number + issue + expiration (if OFLC)

obligations.check: Actual wage paid ≥ greater of (actual wage for similarly-employed workers) and (prevailing wage on the LCA).
obligations.requirement: Pay the "required wage" = greater of (i) the actual wage to all individuals with similar experience/qualifications for the specific employment, or (ii) the prevailing wage for the occupation in the area of intended employment. Cash in hand, free and clear, when due.
obligations.threshold: max(actual_wage, prevailing_wage). A posted wage RANGE satisfies only if the bottom of the range ≥ prevailing wage. Hourly↔annual via 2,080 hrs/yr.
obligations.deadline: Each pay period (at least monthly).
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.731(a); 655.731(a)(1) (actual); 655.731(a)(2) (prevailing); 655.731(c)(1) (cash in hand / free and clear).
obligations.data_needed: Per worker: LCA prevailing_wage (amount+unit+level); employer actual_wage for the role; gross wages paid per period; pay frequency; FT/PT; hours; cohort wage rates.

obligations.check: Required-wage liability begins no later than 30 days after admission, or 60 days after becoming eligible to work (if already present).
obligations.requirement: Obligation attaches when the worker "enters into employment" (first available for work / under employer control); in no case later than 30 days after admission pursuant to the petition, or — if already in the U.S. at approval — 60 days after becoming eligible to work.
obligations.threshold: 30 days after admission; OR 60 days after becoming eligible (already in U.S.).
obligations.deadline: Wage flowing by day 30 (admission) / day 60 (in-country) at the latest, even without assigned work.
obligations.citation: **20 CFR 655.731(c)(6)(i)-(ii)** (paragraph (c)(6) has only (i) and (ii) — **drop the "(iii)"**), with the nonproductive-status cross-reference at **655.731(c)(7)**.
obligations.data_needed: Per worker: consular admission date (I-94) OR in-country eligibility date; entry pathway; first available-for-work date; first pay date.
evidence_required: Per worker: consular admission date (I-94) OR in-country eligibility date

obligations.check: An LCA is withdrawn only when no H-1B worker is employed under it and no investigation is pending; wage/working-condition obligations continue until a superseding LCA or bona fide termination.
obligations.requirement: Withdraw a certified LCA before expiry only if (i) no H-1B/H-1B1/E-3 worker is employed under it and (ii) the Administrator has not commenced an investigation. Required-wage and working-condition obligations continue at any time H-1B workers are employed under the LCA, unless superseded by a subsequently certified LCA. Strike/lockout obligations remain regardless of withdrawal (and regardless of whether workers are employed).
obligations.threshold: Withdrawal blocked while any covered worker is employed under it or an investigation is open. Withdrawal request must be in writing and sent to ETA OFLC. **The regulation specifies NO effective date for withdrawal** — *(original wrongly asserted "withdrawal is effective on the date ETA receives it"; 655.750(b)(2) sets no effective date.)*
obligations.deadline: Obligations run continuously until a valid withdrawal (no workers employed) OR a bona fide termination.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.750(b). Sharpen sub-cites: wage/working-condition continuation = **655.750(b)(3)**; strike-lockout/notice survival = **655.750(b)(4)**.
obligations.data_needed: Per LCA: withdrawal request date + ETA-receipt date; whether any covered worker still employed; open-investigation flag; superseding LCA exists?; bona-fide-termination status per worker.
evidence_required: Per LCA: withdrawal request date + ETA-receipt date
whether any covered worker still employed

obligations.check: H-1B workers afforded working conditions (hours, shifts, vacation, seniority-based preferences) on the same basis as similarly-employed U.S. workers.
obligations.requirement: Attestation 2: employment of H-1B workers will not adversely affect the working conditions of similarly-employed workers; afford the same basis/criteria (hours, shifts, vacation, fringe such as seniority-based training/schedule preferences).
obligations.threshold: Same basis/criteria as similarly-employed U.S. workers (no quantitative threshold).
obligations.deadline: Throughout the longer of LCA validity or H-1B employment.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.732(a) (attestation/scope); 655.732(b) (documentation).
obligations.data_needed: Scheduling/shift/vacation policy; seniority/training-program access rules; H-1B vs U.S.-worker comparison same occupation; complaints alleging adverse effect.
evidence_required: H-1B vs U.S.-worker comparison same occupation

obligations.check: An amended/new H-1B petition (with corresponding certified LCA) filed BEFORE the worker starts work at a new worksite requiring a new LCA.
obligations.requirement: Per Matter of Simeio Solutions and 8 CFR 214.2(h)(2)(i)(E), a change of worksite to an area requiring a new/corresponding LCA is a MATERIAL CHANGE; file an amended/new I-129 with the new certified LCA BEFORE the worker begins at the new location. Same-MSA/commuting-distance moves don't require an amendment (LCA posting still required); short-term placements (655.735) and non-worksite locations also don't, by themselves.
obligations.threshold: Material change = move to an area requiring a new LCA; amended petition due BEFORE work begins. Same-MSA move = no amendment.
obligations.deadline: File the amended/new petition before the worker starts at the new worksite (work may begin upon filing).
obligations.citation: Matter of Simeio Solutions, LLC, 26 I&N Dec. 542 (AAO 2015); 8 CFR 214.2(h)(2)(i)(E); 20 CFR 655.734 (new-site posting still required).
obligations.data_needed: Per worker: approved-petition LCA worksite + MSA; new worksite + MSA; new LCA filing + certification date; amended I-129 filing date; worker start-date at new site; same-MSA determination.
evidence_required: Per worker: approved-petition LCA worksite + MSA

obligations.check: Every worksite where the worker performs work is within the area of intended employment on a certified LCA (or covered by short-term-placement / Simeio amendment).
obligations.requirement: The place of employment must be within the "area of intended employment" — within normal commuting distance of the LCA address; any place in the same MSA/PMSA is deemed within commuting distance. Brief developmental activities and short peripatetic visits are not "places of employment" (peripatetic ≤5 consecutive workdays/visit; based-elsewhere occasional ≤10 consecutive workdays).
obligations.threshold: Within normal commuting distance / same MSA. Non-worksite carve-outs: peripatetic ≤5; based-elsewhere occasional ≤10 consecutive workdays.
obligations.deadline: Continuous.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.715 (definitions); 655.731(a)(2) (PW tied to area of intended employment).
obligations.data_needed: Per worker: current worksite address(es) + MSA; LCA worksite address(es) + MSA; commuting/MSA mapping; consecutive-workday counts at off-LCA locations.
evidence_required: Per worker: current worksite address(es) + MSA

obligations.check: Off-LCA placements stay within the 30-workday (or qualifying 60-workday) safe harbor; wage + lodging + travel conditions met.
obligations.requirement: Place at a non-LCA worksite without a new LCA only if: (a) meets 655.730–734 for the listed area; (b) no strike/lockout at the new site; (c) per day, pays required wage (higher of home-worksite PW or actual wage) PLUS actual lodging (workdays and non-workdays) PLUS actual travel/meals/incidentals. ≤30 workdays/year (default); extendable to 60 only if the worker keeps an office/work station at the permanent worksite, spends substantial time there, and keeps a U.S. residence in the permanent-worksite area. At the cap: file a new LCA for the area or terminate the placement.
obligations.threshold: 30 workdays/1-year period (default); 60 only if the 3 ties-to-permanent-worksite conditions are met. A "workday" = any day the worker performs any work in the short-term area.
obligations.deadline: Stop or file a new LCA on hitting 30 (or qualifying 60) workdays in the rolling year; per-day wage+lodging+travel throughout.
obligations.citation: **20 CFR 655.735(b)(3)(i)-(iii)** (wage + lodging + travel — refine from bare (b)); **655.735(c) / (c)(1)-(3)** (30/60 workday caps + 60-day conditions); **655.735(d)** (workday definition); **655.735(f)** (action at the cap).
obligations.data_needed: Per worker/short-term area: workday count in the rolling 1-year window; flags for the three 60-day conditions; per-day lodging paid; per-day travel/meals/incidentals; required wage paid; strike/lockout flag at new site.
evidence_required: Per worker/short-term area: workday count in the rolling 1-year window

obligations.check: For H-1B1 (Chile/Singapore) and E-3 (Australia) workers, the PAF applies but only items (a)(1)-(a)(6) + paragraphs (b) and (c) — the dependent/willful items (a)(7)-(a)(10) do NOT apply.
obligations.requirement: Verbatim opening note of 20 CFR 655.760: "Paragraphs (a)(1) thru (a)(6) and paragraphs (b) and (c) of this section also apply to the H-1B1 and E-3 visa categories." Dependency/recruitment/non-displacement attestations do not apply to those categories.
obligations.threshold: Required PAF items for H-1B1/E-3 = {(a)(1)..(a)(6)} + retention (c). Items (a)(7)-(a)(10) = N/A.
obligations.deadline: Same 1-working-day assembly + 1-year/3-year retention as H-1B.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.760 (opening applicability note); INA 212(t) / 8 USC 1182(t).
obligations.data_needed: visaCategory (H-1B|H-1B1|E-3); workerId; lcaId.

obligations.check: The PAF (LCA + supporting docs) assembled and available for public examination no later than 1 working day after the LCA is filed.
obligations.requirement: Verbatim 20 CFR 655.760(a) (assembly deadline for the ENTIRE PAF; applies to every LCA and to H-1B1/E-3 per the opening note).
obligations.threshold: 1 working day after filing ("working day" excludes weekends and federal holidays).
obligations.deadline: filingDate + 1 working day.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.760(a); penalty 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1)(vi); DOL WHD Fact Sheet #62F.
obligations.data_needed: lcaFilingDate; pafAssembledDate (or pafFirstAvailableDate); businessCalendar (working days, excluding federal holidays + weekends).
evidence_required: businessCalendar (working days, excluding federal holidays + weekends)

obligations.check: PAF contains a copy of the certified LCA (ETA-9035E/9035) + cover pages (ETA-9035CP); if e-filed, a printout signed by the employer.
obligations.requirement: Verbatim 20 CFR 655.760(a)(1). Foundational PAF document; required for EVERY certified LCA.
obligations.threshold: Exactly one signed, certified ETA-9035/9035E + ETA-9035CP per LCA. E-filings require a wet/e-signed printout.
obligations.deadline: Available for public examination within 1 working day of filing (655.760(a)); retain per 655.760(c).
obligations.data_needed: lcaId/caseNumber; certifiedLcaDocumentPresent (bool); lcaSignedPrintoutPresent (bool, if e-filed); filingMethod (paper|electronic); eta9035cpCoverPagesPresent (bool); lcaCertificationDate; employerSignaturePresent (bool).

obligations.check: If H-1B-dependent or willful violator (and NOT relying solely on exempt workers for the LCA), PAF contains a summary of recruitment methods + time frames of U.S.-worker recruitment.
obligations.requirement: Verbatim 20 CFR 655.760(a)(10) (or copies of pertinent documents). CONDITIONAL — for dependent/willful-violator employers employing non-exempt workers. Supports the 212(n)(1)(G) good-faith-recruitment attestation.
obligations.threshold: A summary documenting recruitment methods AND time frames, or copies of pertinent documents.
obligations.deadline: In PAF within 1 working day of filing; retain per 655.760(c). (Underlying recruitment precedes/accompanies filing per 655.739.)
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.760(a)(10); recruitment attestation 20 CFR 655.739(i)(4) & 655.739; non-displacement 20 CFR 655.738; INA 212(n)(1)(G); penalty 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1)(vi),(b)(2),(b)(3).
obligations.data_needed: h1bDependentOrWillfulViolator (bool); employsNonExemptH1b (bool); recruitmentSummaryPresent (bool); recruitmentMethods (array); recruitmentTimeFrames (date ranges); lcaId; recruitmentDocsPresent (bool).

obligations.check: PAF contains documentation stating the wage rate to be paid.
obligations.requirement: Verbatim 20 CFR 655.760(a)(2). Required for every LCA. Substantively the paid wage must be ≥ greater of actual or prevailing wage (655.731(a)); this item is the statement of the rate.
obligations.threshold: A stated wage rate (salary or hourly). For PAF-completeness, presence of the wage-rate documentation.
obligations.deadline: In PAF within 1 working day of filing (655.760(a)); retain per 655.760(c).
obligations.data_needed: wageRateDocPresent (bool); offeredWageAmount; wageUnit (year|hour|month); positionTitle; workerName/id. (Cross-rule: actualWage, prevailingWage.)

obligations.check: PAF contains a full, clear explanation of the system used to set the "actual wage" (incl. periodic increases).
obligations.requirement: Verbatim 20 CFR 655.760(a)(3) (memo summarizing the system or a copy of the pay scale; payroll records not required but available on enforcement). Required for every LCA. Actual-wage system defined at 655.731(a)(1)/(c)(2).
obligations.threshold: A written explanation/memo OR pay scale documenting how the actual wage is determined, including periodic increases.
obligations.deadline: In PAF within 1 working day of filing; retain per 655.760(c).
obligations.data_needed: actualWageMemoPresent (bool); actualWageMemoDate; lcaFilingDate; describesPeriodicIncreases (bool); occupation/SOC.

obligations.check: PAF contains documentation used to establish the prevailing wage (general source + methodology is what must be public; underlying individual data is NOT public but goes to DOL on enforcement).
obligations.requirement: Verbatim 20 CFR 655.760(a)(4). Required for every LCA. PW rules at 655.731(a)(2)/(b).
obligations.threshold: Documentation identifying the PW source (OES/OFLC PWD, independent authoritative survey) AND methodology/level. Source+methodology description suffices for public exam.
obligations.deadline: In PAF within 1 working day of filing; retain per 655.760(c).
obligations.data_needed: prevailingWageDocPresent (bool); pwSource (OES|NPWC-PWD|independentSurvey|CBA|other); pwLevel (I-IV, if OES); pwSOC; pwAmount; pwValidityDates; methodologyDescriptionPresent (bool).

obligations.check: PAF contains the document(s) satisfying the union/employee notification of 655.734.
obligations.requirement: Verbatim 20 CFR 655.760(a)(5). Required for every LCA. Notice is EITHER to the bargaining rep OR (if none) by posting in two conspicuous locations / electronic notification, on or within 30 days before filing, kept posted 10 days.
obligations.threshold: Unionized: dated copy of notice to the rep. Non-union: copy of the posting showing two locations and posting dates (10-day duration; posted within [filing−30, filing]) OR proof of electronic notification.
obligations.deadline: Notice per 655.734 timing; PAF copy available within 1 working day of filing; retain per 655.760(c).
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.760(a)(5); notice requirement 20 CFR 655.734; penalty 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1)(vi).
obligations.data_needed: noticeDocPresent (bool); noticeType (unionNotice|physicalPosting|electronic); postingStartDate; postingEndDate; postingLocationsCount (int); lcaFilingDate; hasBargainingRepresentative (bool); worksiteAddress.

obligations.check: PAF contains a summary of benefits offered to U.S. workers in the same occupational classifications, with a differentiation statement and a home-country-benefits statement where applicable.
obligations.requirement: Verbatim 20 CFR 655.760(a)(6) (proprietary cost/stock-option details may be omitted; home-country-benefits statement where applicable, see 655.731(c)(3)). Required for every LCA.
obligations.threshold: A benefits summary for the occupational classification + a differentiation statement if benefits vary + (if applicable) a home-country statement.
obligations.deadline: In PAF within 1 working day of filing; retain per 655.760(c).
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.760(a)(6); benefits-parity 20 CFR 655.731(c)(3); penalty 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1)(vi). *(Confirmed verbatim incl. the "(see § 655.731(c)(3))" parenthetical.)*
obligations.data_needed: benefitsSummaryPresent (bool); differentiationStatementPresent (bool, only if benefits differ); homeCountryBenefitsStatementPresent (bool, if applicable); occupation/SOC; benefitsDifferAcrossEmployees (bool).

obligations.check: On a change in corporate structure, PAF contains a sworn statement by a responsible official of the new entity accepting all predecessor-LCA obligations, plus a list of each affected LCA + certification date, and the new entity's actual-wage system + FEIN.
obligations.requirement: Verbatim 20 CFR 655.760(a)(7). CONDITIONAL — applies only on a corporate-structure change (merger/acquisition/reorganization) where the successor relies on predecessor LCAs.
obligations.threshold: One sworn statement signed by a responsible official of the NEW entity + list of all affected LCAs with certification dates + new actual-wage-system description + new FEIN.
obligations.deadline: Placed in the PAF before the new entity employs H-1B workers under predecessor LCAs (655.730(e)(1)) — *(this "before employing" framing is a structural inference, not a verbatim deadline phrase)*; retain per 655.760(c).
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.760(a)(7); successor-in-interest mechanics 20 CFR 655.730(e)(1); penalty 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1)(vi).
obligations.data_needed: corporateStructureChangeOccurred (bool); successorSwornStatementPresent (bool); statementSignedByResponsibleOfficial (bool); affectedLcaList (array of {lcaId, certificationDate}); newEntityActualWageSystemDescribed (bool); newEntityFEIN; changeEffectiveDate.

obligations.check: If the employer used the IRC "single employer" definition to determine H-1B-dependency, PAF contains a list of all entities included in that determination.
obligations.requirement: Verbatim 20 CFR 655.760(a)(8). CONDITIONAL — applies only when the employer aggregates affiliated entities under the IRC single-employer test (IRC 414(b),(c),(m),(o)) to compute dependency.
obligations.threshold: A written list of every entity treated as part of the single employer. (Dependency thresholds: ≤25 FTE → >7; 26-50 → >12; 51+ → ≥15% — 655.736(a)(1)(i)-(iii).)
obligations.deadline: In PAF within 1 working day of filing; retain per 655.760(c).
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.760(a)(8); single-employer/dependency 20 CFR 655.736(d)(7) & 655.736(a)(1)(i)-(iii); penalty 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1)(vi).
obligations.data_needed: usedIrcSingleEmployerDefinition (bool); singleEmployerEntityListPresent (bool); entitiesInSingleEmployer (array); employerFteCount; h1bWorkerCount; dependencyStatus.

obligations.check: If H-1B-dependent and/or a willful violator AND the LCA(s) indicate only "exempt" workers, PAF contains a list of those exempt workers.
obligations.requirement: Verbatim 20 CFR 655.760(a)(9). CONDITIONAL — only for dependent employers / willful violators claiming the exempt exception. Exempt = ≥$60,000/yr OR master's-or-higher in a related specialty (INA 212(n)(3); 655.737).
obligations.threshold: A list naming each exempt worker. $60,000 is the statutory threshold, NOT inflation-adjusted (655.737(b)/(c)).
obligations.deadline: In PAF within 1 working day of filing; retain per 655.760(c).
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.760(a)(9); exempt-worker list/definition 20 CFR 655.737(e)(1) & 655.737(b)-(c); INA 212(n)(3); penalty 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1)(vi).
obligations.data_needed: h1bDependentOrWillfulViolator (bool); lcaIndicatesExemptOnly (bool); exemptWorkerListPresent (bool); exemptWorkers (array of {workerId, basis, wageAmount, degreeLevel, degreeField}).
evidence_required: exemptWorkers (array of {workerId, basis, wageAmount, degreeLevel, degreeField})

obligations.check: The PAF is located at the principal place of business in the U.S. OR at the place of employment, and a member of the public may examine it (transcription/scanning/photograph; copies need not be provided).
obligations.requirement: Location per 20 CFR 655.760(a). Access method per DOL WHD Fact Sheet #62F: must permit capture by transcription, scanning, or photographs; no requirement to provide copies. Applies to every LCA.
obligations.threshold: Location ∈ {principal place of business in U.S., place of employment}. Access: must permit transcription/scanning/photography on request; no mailing/handing-over of copies.
obligations.deadline: Available within 1 working day of filing; maintained through the 655.760(c) retention period.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.760(a) (location); DOL WHD Fact Sheet #62F (access method); penalty 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1)(vi).
obligations.data_needed: pafStorageLocationType (principalPlaceOfBusiness|placeOfEmployment|other); pafAddress; publicExaminationProcessDocumented (bool); allowsTranscriptionScanPhoto (bool); worksiteAddresses (for multi-site).

obligations.check: The public access file for each LCA is assembled and contains every required exhibit (for an H-1B-dependent employer, including the dependent-employer exhibits).
obligations.requirement: PAF contains a copy of the certified LCA (ETA-9035E/9035) + cover pages (ETA-9035CP); if e-filed, a printout signed by the employer. PAF contains documentation stating the wage rate to be paid. PAF contains a full, clear explanation of the system used to set the "actual wage" (incl. periodic increases). PAF contains documentation used to establish the prevailing wage (general source + methodology is what must be public; underlying individual data is NOT public but goes to DOL on enforcement). PAF contains the document(s) satisfying the union/employee notification of 655.734. PAF contains a summary of benefits offered to U.S. workers in the same occupational classifications, with a differentiation statement and a home-country-benefits statement where applicable. If H-1B-dependent or willful violator (and NOT relying solely on exempt workers for the LCA), PAF contains a summary of recruitment methods + time frames of U.S.-worker recruitment. The PAF (LCA + supporting docs) assembled and available for public examination no later than 1 working day after the LCA is filed.
obligations.data_needed: evidence that each required PAF exhibit exists for the LCA (certified LCA copy, wage-rate memo, actual-wage system memo, prevailing-wage documentation, notice of posting, benefits summary, recruitment summary where dependent); the date the file was assembled.
evidence_required: evidence that each required PAF exhibit exists for the LCA (certified LCA copy,
the date the file was assembled

obligations.check: PAF records retained 1 year beyond the last date any H-1B worker is employed under the LCA — or, if none employed, 1 year from LCA expiration/withdrawal.
obligations.requirement: Verbatim 20 CFR 655.760(c). Applies to every LCA.
obligations.threshold: 1 year (365 days) past last-employment-date under the LCA, OR 1 year past expiry/withdrawal if unused.
obligations.deadline: retentionEnd; do not destroy before this date.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.760(c); penalty 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1)(vi); DOL WHD Fact Sheet #62F.
obligations.data_needed: lcaId; lastH1bEmploymentDateUnderLca (nullable); lcaExpiryDate; lcaWithdrawalDate (nullable); anyH1bEmployedUnderLca (bool); pafRecordsRetainedThroughDate; pafStorageLocation.

obligations.check: Payroll records for H-1B employees AND comparator employees in the same occupational classification retained 3 years from creation (indefinitely if enforcement commenced).
obligations.requirement: Verbatim 20 CFR 655.760(c). Payroll records are NOT part of the public-examination file but ARE part of required retention. Applies to every LCA.
obligations.threshold: 3 years (1,095 days) from each record's creation; extended indefinitely if a WHD enforcement action is commenced.
obligations.deadline: recordCreationDate + 3 years per record; hold until enforcement complete if commenced.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.760(c); content of payroll records 20 CFR 655.731(b)(1); penalty 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1)(vi).
obligations.data_needed: payrollRecordCreationDates (per record); payrollRecordsRetainedThroughDate; occupationalClassification; comparatorEmployeesCovered (bool); enforcementActionCommenced (bool); enforcementActionCloseDate (nullable).

obligations.check: Retains a memo/documentation describing the actual-wage system and how the H-1B wage relates to others.
obligations.requirement: Establish the actual wage and RETAIN documentation specifying the basis — a written explanation of the system/factors, showing how the H-1B wage relates to others with similar experience/qualifications.
obligations.threshold: Existence + adequacy of the actual-wage memo.
obligations.deadline: Retained per 655.760(c) (generally 1 year beyond the employment/validity period).
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.731(b); retention 20 CFR 655.760(c).
obligations.data_needed: Boolean: actual-wage memo present; date; whether it identifies the wage-setting factors and ties to payroll.
evidence_required: whether it identifies the wage-setting factors and ties to payroll

obligations.check: Documented, consistently-applied actual-wage system; H-1B paid ≥ similarly-employed in-house workers (after legitimate factors).
obligations.requirement: "Actual wage" = the rate paid to all individuals with experience/qualifications SIMILAR to the H-1B worker, for the SPECIFIC EMPLOYMENT at the place of employment. Pay differences only on legitimate business factors (experience, qualifications, education, job responsibility, specialized knowledge, performance/productivity, geographic location). If no other employees hold the position, actual wage = the H-1B worker's wage.
obligations.threshold: H-1B paid ≥ the actual wage from the documented system for a worker of that experience/qualifications. Differences must trace to enumerated legitimate factors.
obligations.deadline: System exists at filing; documentation retained per 655.760.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.731(a)(1); documentation 20 CFR 655.731(b).
obligations.data_needed: Roster of all employees in the same title/classification with wage, experience years, education, documented differential factor(s); the H-1B worker's experience/education; written actual-wage methodology.
evidence_required: Roster of all employees in the same title/classification with wage

obligations.check: H-1B workers offered benefits + eligibility on the same basis/criteria as U.S. workers.
obligations.requirement: Offer benefits and ELIGIBILITY (provided as compensation) on the SAME BASIS / SAME CRITERIA as U.S. workers. Covered: cash bonuses; stock options/non-cash comp; paid vacations/holidays; health/life/disability/other insurance; retirement/savings. May not deny on "temporary"-status grounds. Home/host-country election rules apply for temporary assignments.
obligations.threshold: Same basis + same criteria (waiting periods, vesting, match, plan access); no "temporary-status" carve-out.
obligations.deadline: Throughout the period of employment.
obligations.data_needed: Benefit-plan eligibility rules U.S. workers vs the H-1B worker (waiting periods, plan tiers, bonus eligibility, equity, PTO accrual, 401k match); actual enrollment/offer.
evidence_required: Benefit-plan eligibility rules U.S. workers vs the H-1B worker (waiting periods,

obligations.check: Every deduction reducing an H-1B worker below the required wage falls within an authorized category.
obligations.requirement: A deduction may reduce below the required wage ONLY if: (i) required by law (taxes, FICA, court-ordered garnishments); OR (ii) CBA-authorized, or reasonable-and-customary (union dues, employee insurance premiums); OR (iii) voluntary meeting ALL of: (A) written + voluntary, (B) NOT a business-expense recoupment, (C) principally for the employee's benefit, (D) ≤ fair market value/actual cost, (E) within FLSA limits / not below the required wage inconsistently. Any deduction failing its category is unauthorized; the shortfall is owed as back wages.
obligations.threshold: Voluntary deductions ≤ FMV/actual cost; not a business-expense recoupment; within FLSA limits / not below the required wage except as (c)(9) permits.
obligations.deadline: Each pay period.
obligations.data_needed: Per deduction line: reason code/description; amount; written-authorization (bool); whether it recoups an employer-benefiting cost; FMV/actual-cost reference; net wage vs required wage.
evidence_required: whether it recoups an employer-benefiting cost

obligations.check: Employer H-1B business expenses (LCA/petition attorney fees, the ACWIA fee) NOT deducted from or shifted to the worker below the required wage.
obligations.requirement: Deductions/required payments recouping the EMPLOYER'S BUSINESS EXPENSES are prohibited where they bring the wage below the required wage. These include: the employer's attorney fees and LCA/petition prep/filing costs; AND the ACWIA training/scholarship fee under INA 214(c)(9) ($1,500 for ≥26 FTE; $750 for ≤25 FTE) — non-recoupable even voluntarily. The $500 fraud-prevention fee is likewise the employer's expense.
obligations.threshold: ACWIA fee $1,500 (≥26 FTE) / $750 (≤25 FTE) — never charged to worker. LCA/petition attorney fees & costs — not chargeable if it drops pay below required wage. $500 fraud fee — employer expense.
obligations.deadline: At the time of any such deduction/payment.
obligations.data_needed: Any worker charge/deduction for: LCA prep, petition prep, attorney fees, ACWIA training fee, $500 fraud fee; employer FTE count (sets $1,500 vs $750); resulting net wage.
evidence_required: Any worker charge/deduction for: LCA prep

obligations.check: No penalty imposed on the worker for ceasing employment before an agreed date (distinguish bona fide liquidated damages).
obligations.requirement: May NOT require the worker to pay a PENALTY for ceasing employment before an agreed date. Penalty-vs-liquidated-damages is determined under State contract law: bona fide liquidated damages (a reasonable pre-estimate of actual loss) permitted; a punitive amount is a prohibited penalty. ACWIA fee can never be characterized as liquidated damages.
obligations.threshold: Permitted only if it qualifies as bona fide liquidated damages under State law; a punitive penalty is prohibited; ACWIA fee never recoverable.
obligations.deadline: At separation / when the charge is imposed.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.731(c)(10)(i) (penalty vs liquidated damages); penalty 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1).
obligations.data_needed: Existence/terms of any early-departure repayment clause; amount; whether a reasonable pre-estimate of loss; governing State; whether ACWIA fee is embedded; whether the worker actually paid.
evidence_required: Existence/terms of any early-departure repayment clause
whether a reasonable pre-estimate of loss

obligations.check: Full required wage paid during employment-related nonproductive time (no "benching").
obligations.requirement: Pay the required wage for ALL nonproductive time caused by conditions RELATED TO EMPLOYMENT (lack of work, lack of permit/license, waiting for a project, studying for a licensing exam). FT → full guaranteed hours; PT → ≥ the LCA/petition hours. NOT required for nonproductive time due to conditions UNRELATED to employment at the worker's voluntary request/convenience or rendering them unable to work — UNLESS otherwise owed under the benefit plan or law (e.g., FMLA). Failing to pay benched time is a per-se violation.
obligations.threshold: Full required wage for employment-related nonproductive time; PT ≥ LCA hours.
obligations.deadline: Each pay period during the nonproductive status.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.731(c)(7)(i)-(ii); DOL WHD Fact Sheet #62I.
obligations.data_needed: Per period: hours/wage paid; employment status (active vs bona-fide-terminated with USCIS notification + return-transportation); nonproductivity reason (employment-related vs voluntary); LCA FT/PT hours range.
evidence_required: employment status (active vs bona-fide-terminated with USCIS notification + retu

obligations.check: On the July-1 OES refresh, do not require a new PWD for an already-filed LCA, but recheck new filings against updated data.
obligations.requirement: OFLC updates OES/OEWS data once per year, effective July 1 (wage year July 1–June 30). Once an LCA is filed within a PWD's validity, no new PWD is required when data updates; the LCA remains valid. PWD requests and LCAs filed on/after July 1 use the refreshed figures.
obligations.threshold: Effective July 1; pre-existing certified LCAs grandfathered; new filings use new data.
obligations.deadline: July 1 annually.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.731(a)(2)(ii) (OES survey); OFLC OEWS wage-year update (effective July 1).
obligations.data_needed: LCA filing date vs the active wage-year boundary (July 1); cited wage-data vintage; PWD validity dates.
evidence_required: LCA filing date vs the active wage-year boundary (July 1)

obligations.check: PT H-1B workers paid the required wage for hours worked, and ≥ the LCA-stated minimum hours.
obligations.requirement: For PT, pay the required wage for the hours actually worked, and for at least the petition/LCA hours (the LCA states a range or number). The required HOURLY wage governs; may not be paid for fewer hours than the LCA minimum.
obligations.threshold: hours_paid ≥ LCA_minimum_hours; hourly_rate_paid ≥ required_hourly_wage.
obligations.deadline: Each pay period.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.731(c)(7)(ii); 20 CFR 655.731(a) (required hourly wage).
obligations.data_needed: LCA FT/PT flag; LCA stated hours (min/max or specific); hours paid per period; hourly required wage (PW & actual converted to hourly).
evidence_required: hourly required wage (PW & actual converted to hourly)

obligations.check: Required wage paid "cash in hand, free and clear, when due" — net of only authorized deductions.
obligations.requirement: Pay CASH IN HAND, FREE AND CLEAR, WHEN DUE — legal tender/negotiable instrument, at period close, no kickback. Only 655.731(c)(9) deductions may reduce below the required wage. Report as earnings with proper IRS/FICA withholding. Pay at least as frequently as the prevailing practice / at least monthly.
obligations.threshold: Net cash (after only authorized deductions) ≥ required wage for the period; paid no later than when due (at least monthly).
obligations.deadline: Each regular payday; "when due."
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.731(c)(7); cash-wage documentation 20 CFR 655.731(c)(8)/(c)(12).
obligations.data_needed: Per period: gross pay; each deduction line + reason code; net cash paid; pay date vs period-end; pay frequency; IRS/FICA withholding evidence.

obligations.check: Wage obligation begins no later than 30 days after admission (or 60 days after becoming eligible if already in the U.S.).
obligations.requirement: Obligation begins when the worker "enters into employment," but no later than 30 days after first admission pursuant to the petition, or 60 days after becoming eligible to work if already present (COS). Enters into employment = first available for work / under employer control (orientation, etc.).
obligations.threshold: Pay starts by min(actual entry, admission+30) or by eligibility+60 (if already in U.S.).
obligations.deadline: 30 days (consular) / 60 days (in-US COS).
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.731(c)(6); DOL WHD Fact Sheet #62G.
obligations.data_needed: US admission date (I-94); work-eligibility date (COS); first entered-employment date; first paycheck date.

obligations.check: The wage level (I-IV) on the PWD matches the position's MINIMUM requirements per the OFLC 5-factor worksheet.
obligations.requirement: Every OES-based determination STARTS at Level I and adjusts upward via a 5-step worksheet comparing the EMPLOYER'S MINIMUM requirements against O*NET norms: Step 1 Level I baseline; Step 2 +1 if experience exceeds the SVP norm; Step 3 +1 if education exceeds the usual; Step 4 +1 for special skills/licenses beyond the norm; Step 5 +1 for supervisory duties. Levels map to OES percentiles: I=17th, II=34th, III=50th, IV=67th. Set from the position's MINIMUM requirements, not the incumbent's actual credentials.
obligations.threshold: I=17th, II=34th, III=50th, IV=67th percentile; worksheet adds at most ~one level per factor; start at I.
obligations.deadline: Determined at PWD issuance; binds the LCA filed within validity.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.731(a)(2)(ii)(A); DOL OFLC Prevailing Wage Determination Policy Guidance (rev. Nov 2009).
obligations.data_needed: Position SOC + O*NET Job Zone/SVP; minimum required experience years; minimum education; required special skills/licenses; supervises?; PWD's stated level + percentile; OES wage per level for that SOC/area.
evidence_required: OES wage per level for that SOC/area

obligations.check: AUDIT RED FLAG — a low wage level (esp. Level I) attested for a senior/complex/supervisory title or one whose stated requirements imply seniority.
obligations.requirement: A Level I ("entry," routine tasks under close supervision) wage attested for a role that is senior/lead/architect/principal/managerial — or carries elevated experience/education/supervisory requirements — is internally inconsistent and a recognized indicator of PW understatement. Same for Level II on a clearly senior role.
obligations.threshold: Heuristic: Level I with (title contains senior/lead/principal/staff/architect/manager/director) OR (min experience ≥ ~3-5 yrs) OR (supervisory=true) OR (advanced degree required for a non-entry role) → flag.
obligations.deadline: Detect at filing and on audit.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.731(a)(2); DOL OFLC PW Determination Policy Guidance (rev. Nov 2009) (level definitions).
obligations.data_needed: Wage level on LCA; job title text; seniority keywords; min experience years; supervisory flag; required degree level; the SOC's typical level distribution.

obligations.check: The LCA was filed while its supporting NPWC PWD was within the PWD validity window.
obligations.requirement: An NPWC PWD specifies a validity period ≥90 days and ≤1 year (365 days) from determination. To rely on the safe harbor, file the LCA (or, for PERM, file/begin recruitment) during that window. Once filed within validity, the LCA remains valid for its certified period.
obligations.threshold: 90 ≤ PWD validity ≤ 365 days; filing date ∈ [determination date, expiration date].
obligations.deadline: LCA filed on/before the PWD expiration date.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.731(a)(2)(ii)(A); DOL OFLC NPWC guidance (validity period).
obligations.data_needed: PWD determination/issue date; PWD expiration date; LCA filing date.

obligations.check: On a wage challenge, confirm whether the employer obtained and properly applied an NPWC PWD (safe harbor).
obligations.requirement: If the employer obtains an NPWC PWD, files the LCA, and pays per the PWD, WHD will not challenge the PW validity in an enforcement action — provided the PWD was applied properly (correct occupation, area, and skill/wage level). Does not immunize misclassification of level/occupation/area.
obligations.threshold: Safe harbor only if occupation, area, AND wage level were all correctly applied.
obligations.deadline: n/a (defensive posture).
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.731(a)(2)(ii)(A); 20 CFR 655.731(d) (PWD reliance).
obligations.data_needed: PWD present?; PWD SOC, area, level vs the actual job's SOC/area/level; wage paid vs PWD wage.
evidence_required: level vs the actual job's SOC/area/level

obligations.check: The prevailing wage was obtained from one of the four permitted sources.
obligations.requirement: Set PW using ONE of: (i) an arm's-length CBA rate (controls if covered); (ii) an OFLC NPWC PWD (arithmetic mean of similarly-employed workers, OES/OEWS unless an acceptable employer survey); (iii) an independent authoritative survey; or (iv) the DBA/SCA wage for covered contracts. For H-1B: (a) NPWC PWD, (b) independent authoritative survey, or (c) another legitimate source.
obligations.threshold: Source ∈ the four enumerated types; CBA controls where applicable; DBA/SCA controls on covered contracts.
obligations.deadline: Source/PWD valid as of filing; documentation retained per 655.760.
obligations.data_needed: PW source type enum (NPWC_PWD | CBA | independent_survey | DBA | SCA); source document/ID; PW value; SOC + area.
evidence_required: PW source type enum (NPWC_PWD | CBA | independent_survey | DBA | SCA)

obligations.check: Any employer-provided/independent survey for the PW meets all regulatory validity criteria.
obligations.requirement: An independent authoritative survey (or "other legitimate source") must: (1) reflect the arithmetic mean (or weighted average; or median where only a median is provided); (2) be for the SAME occupation; (3) be in the area of intended employment; (4) be based on data collected within 24 months of publication; AND (5) the edition used must have been published within the 24-month period immediately preceding filing. For "other legitimate source," data also latest and across-industry unless the job is in that industry.
obligations.threshold: Published within 24 months before filing; data collected within 24 months before publication; mean (or median) of similarly-employed workers in the occupation and area.
obligations.deadline: Currency measured at the filing date.
obligations.data_needed: Survey publication date; data-collection date; statistic type (mean/median/weighted avg); occupation + geographic + industry scope; LCA filing date.

obligations.check: On any wage/benefit shortfall, back wages (and fringe) = difference between required and paid for the full violation period.
obligations.requirement: WHD shall assess and oversee payment of BACK WAGES (or fringe benefits) = (amount that should have been paid) − (amount actually paid), for the entire violation period, to the affected worker(s).
obligations.threshold: Back wages = Σ over the violation period of (required − actual) per worker; back fringe = (required benefit value − provided).
obligations.deadline: Assessed on enforcement finding; for the violation period (within the limitations/retention window).
obligations.data_needed: Per worker per period: required wage; actual paid; hours; deduction amounts; benefit values; violation start/end.
evidence_required: Per worker per period: required wage

obligations.check: Map a found violation to the correct CMP tier + per-violation cap.
obligations.requirement: Three tiers (statutory base, annually inflation-adjusted): TIER 1 up to $2,364 for a substantial failure (strike/lockout, U.S.-worker displacement, substantial notification/LCA-specificity/recruitment failures, material misrepresentation, an early-cessation penalty, the worker paying the $500/ACWIA fees, impeding the Administrator). TIER 2 up to $9,624 for a willful failure / willful misrepresentation / whistleblower discrimination. TIER 3 up to $67,367 for a willful violation that resulted in DISPLACEMENT of a U.S. worker in the 90-days-before/90-days-after window.
obligations.threshold: Caps (2026): $2,364 / $9,624 / $67,367. Displacement window = 90 days before to 90 days after petition filing. Per-violation (per worker/occurrence).
obligations.deadline: Assessed at enforcement; figures re-indexed each January.
obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1)-(3); inflation adjustment 20 CFR Part 356 / DOL CMP Adjustment final rule.
obligations.data_needed: Violation type; willfulness determination; whether a U.S. worker was displaced; petition filing date + 90-day windows; affected-worker count.
evidence_required: whether a U.S. worker was displaced

obligations.check: Map a found violation to the minimum debarment (program-disqualification) period.
obligations.requirement: On a finding, the employer is disqualified from LCA approval and from filing H-1B / other employment-based petitions for: ≥1 year (substantial/willful per (b)(1)); ≥2 years (willful per (b)(2)); ≥3 years (willful + displacement per (b)(3)). DOL notifies DHS, which may not approve petitions for the period.
obligations.deadline: Runs from the date DHS receives the debarment notice.
obligations.data_needed: Violation tier (from cmp-tiers rule); willfulness; displacement finding.

obligations.check: Paid wage ≥ greater of (actual wage, prevailing wage) for the entire period of authorized employment.
obligations.requirement: Attest on the LCA to pay the "required wage rate" = greater of (1) actual wage to others with similar experience/qualifications for the specific employment, or (2) prevailing wage for the occupation in the area. Runs for the full authorized-employment period.
obligations.threshold: paid_wage ≥ MAX(actual_wage, prevailing_wage). No de minimis — any underpayment is a violation.
obligations.deadline: Continuous, entire authorized-employment period.
obligations.data_needed: Per worker: actual gross wage paid; pay frequency; actual_wage benchmark; prevailing_wage; LCA validity start/end; FT/PT; hours.
evidence_required: Per worker: actual gross wage paid
